=== Block ownership for the env refs ===
line 173 belongs to service: agent-orchestration
line 175 belongs to service: agent-orchestration
line 718 belongs to service: frontend

=== frontend OpenAPI proxy: does /app/ depend on comment openapi at runtime? ===
01-frontend/frontend/src/api-clients/comments-module/client.gen.ts:16:export const client = createClient(createConfig<ClientOptions2>({ baseUrl: 'http://localhost:18008' }));
01-frontend/frontend/src/api-clients/comments-module/types.gen.ts:4:    baseUrl: 'http://localhost:18008' | (string & {});
718:      - VITE_COMMENTS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18008/openapi.json

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== Block ownership for the env refs ==="
for ln in 173 175 718; do
  svc=$(awk -v l=$ln 'NR<=l && /^  [a-z0-9_-]+:\s*$/ {n=$0} END{print n}' process-compose.yaml | tr -d ' :' )
  echo "line $ln belongs to service: $svc"
done
echo
echo "=== frontend OpenAPI proxy: does /app/ depend on comment openapi at runtime? ==="
grep -rn "VITE_COMMENTS_OPENAPI_URL\|18008" 01-frontend/frontend/src 2>/dev/null | head -5
grep -n "VITE_COMMENTS_OPENAPI_URL\|COMMENTS" process-compose.yaml | head
